notes: Tuition: the pages state fees only as 'part fixe' plus a variable part based on family income, without a single figure applicable to a non-EU applicant, so no tuition fact is recorded. The Parcoursup page's 'Niveau de français requis : B2' is the only stated admission language condition; the Campus France pages say the French certificate is obligatory for the Etudes en France procedure (with exemptions) and mention recommended levels, not hard requirements for this programme. Intakes: no academic-year start date, opening date or dated application deadline with a year was found for this programme. applicationChannel is deliberately omitted per the task.
